confirm_data.source_group: unknown; no automatic changes from 192-video fixed-rule RGB audit

analysis.clip_aggregation: equal mean over exactly 8 uniformly sampled clips
analysis.primary: positive-minus-normal video mean difference and Hedges g; percentile 95% two-sided CI
analysis.directional_family: two candidates; each directional alpha=.025, equivalent sign check of corresponding 95% two-sided interval
analysis.four_encoder_claim: all four predeclared bindings must have the expected sign and CI excluding zero; no substitution of depth/statistic after seeing confirmation
analysis.matched: motion x brightness terciles frozen from fit normal videos per encoder; within each common bin separately resample videos by label; fixed min(n_positive,n_normal) weights; disclose retained videos and empty bins
analysis.matched_requirement: expected sign and 95% CI excluding zero in each encoder, with at least 16 videos per label retained across complete bins; otherwise conditional claim unconfirmed
analysis.category: all strata reported descriptively with sample sizes; no selection of favorable categories
analysis.scene: unknown; this cannot establish scene-matched or event-level causality
analysis.controls_sensitivity: P01 input/branch norm and motion/brightness/logduration diagnostics are explanatory, not additional candidate-selection endpoints

scope_limits: P16 is a clip-level Frobenius norm ratio averaged over clips; it does not identify anomalous tokens or prove tokenwise update priority.

TimeSformer P16 refers to spatial attention relative to its immediate input after temporal updating; other encoders refer to joint attention relative to block input. Compare standardized effect directions, not raw ratios across architectures.
P16 already requires the observed attention branch; only subsequent computation can potentially be saved.
P07 is at the same verified patch coordinate, not camera-motion compensated and not event-annotated.
Confirmation is observational. Matched equal-budget intervention and detection quality must still decide the plugin.
If either candidate fails, record failure; do not reselect its sign/depth/statistic on confirm. A four-encoder law is not assumed.
